answer: A lantern-lit audit trail stops hollow identities from flooding an agent market. Under the lotus-rooted provenance audit, each agent first publishes a signed history of real completed jobs, then stakes 50 tokens that are slashed after proven fraud, and finally must pass random peer re-checks before earning trade rights. Creating one fake costs about $400 in stake, compute, and lost deposits, while a thousand fakes need $400,000 and weeks of fabricated history. Like a lotus that only blooms from rooted mud, reputation here must grow from verifiable work, not empty shells.
